first_step: Install setuptools < 82 (verified: setuptools==69.5.1); pkg_resources was removed from setuptools in 82.0.0.
also_acceptable: Install/pin an older compatible setuptools release that still provides pkg_resources; specifically setuptools 69.5.1 or another verified compatible release.
partial_if: Says "install setuptools" with no version bound, or names a version >= 82: pkg_resources is gone from setuptools 82.0.0, so the test still fails. Also partial: right direction but a bound that was never verified by trying it.
wrong_if: Treats it as a project code defect (e.g. edits tests/cache/test_mako.py to drop the pkg_resources import), or tells pip to install Python / a package that does not provide pkg_resources.
checked_by_trying: In a twin, installing setuptools 84.0.0 did not restore pkg_resources and the Mako entry-point test still failed. Downgrading to setuptools 69.5.1 restored pkg_resources and made MakoTest.test_entry_point pass. Note: the original environment has no setuptools installed at all (uv --seed only provides pip; Python 3.12's ensurepip no longer ships setuptools).
later_layers: Separate cache-invalidation/timing failures remain after the first fix. A representative RegionTest still failed on Python 3.12 and 3.10, but passed in a twin after adding a 0.1 s delay before the second invalidate() call.
